{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Cross-tabulate channel with customer_segment to check for imbalance
customer_segment_cross = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print("Customer segment distribution by channel:")
print(customer_segment_cross)

# Cross-tabulate channel with customer_age to check for imbalance
# Use age groups to avoid too many categories
age_bins = [0, 25, 35, 50, 100]
age_labels = ['<25', '25-35', '35-50', '50+']
df['age_group'] = pd.cut(df['customer_age'], bins=age_bins, labels=age_labels, right=False)
age_group_cross = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['age_group'])
print("\nAge group distribution by channel:")
print(age_group_cross)"}
